full.en: Hazelnutchocolatespread-creamy,200g.Ingredients: HAZELNUT paste* (60%), coconut sugar*, cocoa paste* (13%). * Controlled organic farming. The product may contain traces of other NUTS. Storage: Store in a dry and dark place. After opening store in the refrigerator and use within 30 days.
